capabilities: Create recalls (flashcards) from selected text in notes
Edit and delete existing recalls from a recall card
Link each recall to the note block with a highlight ID
Sync created recalls with the iDoRecall web app via API key
extras: Free iDoRecall accounts allow up to 200 recalls. Source links only work on desktop, and recall creation fails on Canvas/Excalidraw text. Users must not delete the highlight IDs the plugin inserts into notes, or source navigation breaks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced-repetition system, and flashcards made elsewhere don't link back to the exact note text where the material was learned.

relations.evidence: The iDoRecall Obsidian plugin is a companion plugin for the iDoRecall web application.

summary: Companion plugin for the iDoRecall spaced-repetition web app that creates flashcards linked to selected text in Obsidian notes.
